item.title: LaMelo Ball hits career-high 10 3s, scores 37 points to help Hornets rout Wizards
item.description: WASHINGTON (AP) — LaMelo Ball made a career-high 10 3-pointers and scored 37 points to help the Charlotte Hornets rout the Washington Wizards 129-112 on Sunday night for a four-game season sweep.
